free_tier.stated: OpenAI-compatible inference through TEE-backed providers on a decentralized network, priced per model: Gemma 4 26B at USD 0.15 input and USD 0.40 output per 1M tokens, Kimi K2.5 at USD 0.60 and USD 3.00. Access without paying per token is bought by staking: 'Stake your MOR to get inference from the Morpheus network.'

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Morpheus also pays up to 12% APR on deposited stETH, WETH, USDC or USDT, so capital placed there earns MOR that can be restaked for inference; the loop needs capital at the start, which a user does not have.

limits.value: Every route needs MOR: either per-token payment or a stake that converts to a daily inference session, and MOR must be bought on an exchange first.

notes: The MOR-per-inference conversion rate is not published on the pages read; mor.org/calc.html is the comparison tool and runs client-side. Without that rate the staking route cannot be priced, and a per-token comparison at USD 0.15 per 1M input is close to centralized list prices, so the stake is a convenience, not a discount, unless the rate is generous.
